info.name: SugarCrumbs API (local)
info.description:
Local API for the SugarCrumbs baker backend (modular monolith).

**Auth:** run *Auth → Log in* first (set `ownerEmail`/`ownerPassword` to your `APP_OWNER_EMAIL`/`APP_OWNER_INITIAL_PASSWORD`). Owner routes need the saved Bearer token; shopper routes live under `/api/public/**` and need none. Login is rate-limited to 5 per minute per IP, guest checkout to 10 per 10 minutes.

**Suggested order:** Auth → Log in; Catalogue → Create category → Create item; Availability → set working hours; Orders → Guest checkout → Accept / Reject.

Ids from create requests are saved automatically into collection variables (categoryId, itemId, orderId, blockedDateId). Dates (`tomorrow`, `dayAfterTomorrow`, `nextWeek`, `tzOffset`) are recomputed before every request. Pickup times (`slotAt`, `rescheduleAt`) are picked from live availability, so the run can be repeated. Each run leaves its category, ordered item and orders in the DB: ordered items can't be deleted until #14.

exec: // Recomputed before every request so dates are always in the future.
const plusDays = n => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d; };
// The server reads order times in its own zone (same machine), so send the local offset.

item.name: Auth (run first)
item.description: Log in as the Owner. The access token is saved to `accessToken`, which every request sends as a Bearer token (collection auth). It lasts 15 minutes: run **Refresh** (or Log in again) when requests start returning 401. Public requests ignore the header.

item.name: Catalogue (owner)

request.description: Names must be unique. Saves `categoryId`.
Throwaway category for the delete request below. The main `categoryId` is kept because items and orders later in the run depend on it. Saves `tmpCategoryId`.
Fails with 409 while items still use the category.
All filters are optional; enable any of them.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Cinnamon Roll",
  "description": "Soft roll with cream cheese icing",
  "price": 4.5,
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "leadTimeHours": 0,
  "stockQuantity": 12
}

request.description: `stockQuantity: null` (or omitted) means unlimited stock. Saves `itemId`.
Unavailable items can't be booked.
Negative to decrement. Fails for unlimited-stock items.

Uploads `docs/postman/fixtures/sample-item.png` (path relative to the repo root: run the CLI from there, or set it as the Postman app working directory). PNG/JPEG/WEBP only, max 10MB. Uploaded files aren't served yet (#8).
409 if any order references the item; mark it unavailable instead.

exec: // Pick the first bookable slot between tomorrow and next week, so repeated runs
// don't collide with slots taken by earlier runs (capacity is 1 per slot).
throw new Error('no bookable slot between tomorrow and next week: set working hours first');

request.description: `pickupAt` must be the start of a bookable slot. Saves `orderId`.
All filters optional; from+to must be used together.
Case-insensitive search on the reference and the guest's name, email and phone. `status` may repeat; `from`/`to` may each be left out.
PENDING → CONFIRMED
CONFIRMED → IN_PROGRESS
CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS → FULFILLED

request.description: PENDING only. The full list of lines wanted: items left out are removed. Items already on the order keep the price the guest saw; stock moves by the difference.
PENDING only. Blank or absent clears the notes.
Only a confirmed order is cancelled; a pending one is rejected.
CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS → CANCELLED. A pending order is rejected instead (400). Releases slot capacity and tracked stock.
